provenance.role: access lane splitting a large block (its place and bends estimated)
provenance.basis: research/rome09_fascist_whole_basis.md; prati source footprint and its own named housing comparison. Whole lots and inferred access lanes are estimated, not individual dwelling counts. Native court-first/frontage remainder is layout output, not a sourced census share. Corrected TCI1925 four-road source and selection domain; native local relayout after the imported seven-road layer was found to extend south into Borgo. Only existing other owners/public footprints are reserved. No existing Borgo is demolished. Incoming old Prati lots are replaced, not reserved. Original court6 type/storeys/sizing/block parameters unchanged. Native front remainder uses the same approved whole-perimeter court6 building, never a new row type or apartments cut from a known court. Front widths >=20m and depths20–25m remain within the source-constrained20–48m court envelope; six storeys, court fraction.22, roof and all house-type geometry are unchanged. Court-first then frontage is native lots_of, not a separate packer. These estimated lot positions do not assert surveyed cadastre or prevalence.
